open_questions.answer: Not a real constraint. This was filed by cycle #4 when runner/llm.py wrongly classified a routine per-minute rate limit as a permanent failure. The free tier returns identical wording for 'model not on your tier' and 'too many requests per minute', and that string had been listed as a permanent marker. Fixed in commit 258c8e2: only a depleted prepaid balance is now treated as permanent, calls are paced at 4.5s to stay under ~15 RPM, and the API's own RetryInfo delay is honoured. Cycle #5 then completed cleanly on gemini-3.6-flash under the same conditions. The model is available; treat this question as closed and do not plan around it.
